description: Dog years to human years by size, the way vets count them, not times seven. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

months.description: Months on top of the years, 0–11. Use months alone for a puppy under a year (years 0, months 4).

size.description: Adult size, because big dogs age faster: small up to 9 kg / 20 lb, medium 9–23 kg / 21–50 lb, large 23–45 kg / 51–100 lb, giant over 45 kg / 100 lb. Use the expected adult size for a puppy.

years.description: The dog's age in whole years. Combine with months, e.g. years 3 and months 6 for three and a half.

name: dog_age_calculator
title: Dog Age Calculator
